name: Input Buffer
description: Holds your clicks for 2-8 extra frames so early taps still count.

extra-frames.name: Extra Frames
extra-frames.description: How many extra frames (at 60 FPS) each click is held for after you let go.

buffer-movement.name: Buffer Platformer Movement
buffer-movement.description: Also delay releasing left/right in platformer mode. Off by default because it makes you slide.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Runs levels in test mode so completions and percentages aren't saved while the buffer is on.
